Soaring and opulently appointed, only the [[princes of Vabbi]] usually gaze upon its splendor. }} '''Dasha Vestibule''' is the hidden entrance to the secret refuge of the [[Prince of Vabbi|Princes of Vabbi]]. It is rumored to hold fabulous riches that are protected by deadly guardians. ==Getting there== If you previously chose to follow [[Margrid the Sly]], the [[primary quest]] [[Greed and Regret]] will conclude in this outpost. If you chose to follow the [[Master of Whispers]] instead, it is still possible to gain entry, but only after completion of the primary quest [[Calling the Order]]. Head northwest out of [[Honur Hill]] in [[The Mirror of Lyss]] towards the second closest [[Resurrection Shrine]]. Watch the wall; it will crumble as you near it, revealing the entrance to this outpost. It is to the right of this Resurrection Shrine. It changes into the icon for a mission outpost only upon completion of the quest that precedes the [[Dasha Vestibule|Dasha Vestibule mission]] or [[Dzagonur Bastion|Dzagonur Bastion mission]], which is [[Greed and Regret]] or [[Calling the Order]]. * This outpost and the associated [[Hidden City of Ahdashim]] do not contribute to the [[Elonian Cartographer]] because they are underground, and do not appear on the [[World Map]]. {{Towns and outposts in Vabbi}}
